title: One of the best tours we have ever taken
text:
One of the Best Tours We've Ever Taken

We had an incredible private tour with We Are Guides Barcelona, exploring the medieval cities of Besalú, Girona, and the charming village of Pals. From start to finish, everything was top-notch. Our guide was engaging, knowledgeable, and passionate, bringing each location to life with fascinating stories and insights. The driver was professional and courteous, and we rode in a spotless, brand-new Mercedes van that made the journey comfortable and smooth. We've taken many tours over the years, and this was truly one of the best—an unforgettable day explor
author: S7775CBamyr

title: Breathtaking and beautiful
text: What an amazing look into Spain's historical past and beautiful country! We couldn't have asked for a better tour guide! Breathtaking views, an amazing lunch and so much fun. This is a must-see tour!
author: Corey_C

title: Excellent tour of Besalu, Girona and Pals.
text: Really fantastic tour of Besalu, Girona and Pals. The medieval towns are each charming and beautiful to see. The tour was filled with interesting history of each town. Our guide was excellent, and the lunch was delicious in a delicious local restaurant. It was a great day!
author: Shelly_N

title: Old country charm!
text:
Feliciano was a wonderful guide, he took us to Besalú first, charming old town. We told him we  had been to Girona the same day we went to the Dalí Museum. He didnt want us to see the same town twice, so he took us to Tossa. The old town was great and found out that Ava Gardner made the movie Pandora in 1950 in that town.
Then we had a wonderful lunch in town.
author: Arden_C

title: Dont' miss this amazing experience!
text: What a fabulous day we had with Miguel.  His commentary was thorough and insightful.  We enjoyed each of the towns that we visited, as well as the rides in between towns.  The local luncheon is something that we will remember forever.  I highly recommend this tour as a way to see Eastern Spain outside of Barcelona.  Hats off!
author: Kathryn_B

title: Great tour outside Barcelona
text:
Feliciano was a great tour guide. 
Knew history and current events and was able to meld them together into a compelling story. Without him it would have been just looking at some old stuff.
author: Philip_M

title: What more could you ask for
text: Our tour guide was Feliciano. He was very charming, punctual, professional and a pleasure to be around. He was always explaining the history, social fabric and hidden wonders of these beautiful towns. Our tour was in early April and the weather was perfect at 20 degrees Celsius. The canola fields were all in flower and together with the olive tree plantations and diverse natural vegetation the drive was all the more enchanting to these breathtaking towns. Lunch was delicious and authentic. This was my favourite tour taken in Barcelona.
author: Brett G

title: Medieval Towns
text: So much to see and experience on this tour, the villages are unbelievable and so much history, brought to life by the guide Feliciano, The Lunch was really good and we all had lots of fun.
author: Ruth L F

title: A Perfect Day
text: Feliciano spoiled us! The meeting point was easily  located. The towns we visited were unique among themselves. Feliciano is one of the best guides I have had the pleasure to travel with. His knowledge base about Spainish history is profound. Architecture, art, music , literature and an accurate timeline come easily to him. In addition he discusses current social and political issues and their impact on communities in and around Spain.
